sentence: We can use the Pythagorean theorem since \( QU \), \( UT \), and \( QT \) form a right triangle with \( QU \) and \( UT \) as the legs and \( QT \) as the hypotenuse.

sentence:
This is equivalent to finding \( 4273 \mod 100 \):
\[ 4273 \div 100 = 42 \text{ remainder } 73 \]
So,
\[ 4273 \equiv 73 \pmod{100} \]
